posts.title: Phishing 3.0: The Fight Moves to Agent Versus Agent

slides.text:
Phishing 3.0: The Fight Moves to Agent Versus
Phishing 3.0: The Fight Moves to Agent Versus Agent

Most email defenses still do the job they did a decade ago.
Scan the message, look for something malicious, block it.
That worked when the danger sat in the payload, a bad link or an attachment.
It stopped working when the danger moved into the message's intent, and it is failing now that the sender is no longer a person.
THE TAKEAWAY — Malicious links, infected attachments, spam.
